name: Recovery labels versus remaining requirements
precise_gap: Complete teacher continuations can omit independently required events; prevalence and strength beyond LAW/RM are unknown.
success_criterion: Reliable natural annotation and improved completion beyond matched strong teachers, separating efficiency.
scope: Bounded reviewed literature; not a universal unsolved claim

name: Route validity versus navigator difficulty
precise_gap: Success and compatibility are model-relative; independent clause evidence may identify different errors.
success_criterion: Better selection and downstream instruction following under equal pool, human effort and updates than strong quality/hardness controls.
scope: Bounded reviewed literature; not a universal unsolved claim

name: Attribution before negative semantic writes
precise_gap: A release-level conditional harm path exists; naturally consequential contamination and identifying evidence remain untested.
success_criterion: Reduced downstream suppression beyond quarantine without stale-memory harm under fixed retrieval/feedback.
scope: Bounded reviewed literature; not a universal unsolved claim

name: Ordered future-event information
precise_gap: First moments can alias ordered events, but predictive-question representations already cover the mechanism.
success_criterion: A distinct, predictable real-data ranking/cost result beyond matched GVF, sequence and future-QA controls.
scope: Bounded reviewed literature; not a universal unsolved claim

name: Value of extra evidence under a full budget
precise_gap: New sensing, cached reasoning and more calls are often intertwined.
success_criterion: Matched factorial sensing/reasoning controls with all-episode travel, rotations, latency and false decisions.
scope: Bounded reviewed literature; not a universal unsolved claim

name: Calibration of the needed decision event
precise_gap: Semantic novelty, answer inclusion and finite-budget physical completion are distinct.
success_criterion: Correctly specified event and calibration unit with held-out scene/policy risk, coverage and complete cost accounting.
scope: Bounded reviewed literature; not a universal unsolved claim
